description: Asks a business's own receptionist (Belle) a question and returns her answer: opening hours, emergencies, call-out costs, areas served. She answers only from what the business has told her and says when she does not know, as she does for any customer. The answer carries a conversation_id that continues the same conversation. If the person wants to go ahead she may take their details and pass the request to the business; that is not a booking. The first message tells her an AI assistant is asking for a customer.

agent_name.description: Which assistant is asking, for example Claude.

conversation_id.description: From an earlier answer, to continue the same conversation. Leave out to start a new one.

message.description: The question, in plain language, up to about 600 characters.

name: ask_business
title: Ask a business's receptionist
